prompt:
Create a coordinated TripLOG reservation wallet mockup with three compact mobile screens: reservation list, reservation detail, and reservation editor. Match the existing application: white background, original black TRIPLOG wordmark with a pink LOG box, dark ink #0b1020, lemon yellow #fff05a, sky blue #bce6fb, pale pink #f7afc7, thin dark borders, small offset shadows, and outline icons. Use no destination photographs. Keep a consistent hierarchy: 24px screen titles, 15px reservation names, 13px content, 12px labels, and 44px primary buttons. Use clear alignment and restrained bold text.

List screen: logo and close button, “예약 지갑”, “오사카·교토 가족여행”, a compact search field “예약명·장소·예약번호 검색”, and a single horizontally scrolling filter row “전체 5”, “교통 2”, “숙소 1”, “입장권 1”, “기타 1”. Select “전체 5” in yellow. Show “예약 5건” and “날짜순”. Group compact white bordered reservation cards under “9월 25일 (금)” and “9월 26일 (토)”. Cards show a small category icon, category label, reservation name, date and time, optional location, and a clearly separated reservation-number row with a copy action. Include “제주항공 · 인천 → 오사카”, “9.25 금 · 09:10”, “ABC123”, “복사”; “난바 호텔”, “9.25 금 – 9.27 일 · 2박”, “HTL89024”, “복사”; and “오사카성 입장권”, “9.26 토 · 14:00”, “예약번호 입력”. Keep a yellow “+ 예약 추가” button above the small bottom navigation “오늘”, “점검”, “예약”, “도구”.

Detail screen: logo, close, “예약 상세”, a pink “숙소” label and “난바 호텔”. Use compact sections for “체크인 · 체크아웃”, “9.25 금 – 9.27 일 · 2박”, “예약번호”, “HTL89024”, and a yellow-tinted “복사” action. Show “주소 · 장소”, “오사카시 주오구 난바 1-2-3”, a blue “Google 지도” action, and “메모”, “체크인 15:00 · 여권 준비”. Include clear “예약 수정” and subdued “삭제” controls, with a yellow “일정에 추가” action at the bottom.

Editor screen: logo, close, “예약 추가”, compact category buttons “교통”, “숙소”, “입장권”, “기타” with 숙소 selected in yellow. Show neatly aligned fields for “예약 이름”, “난바 호텔”; side-by-side “체크인”, “9.25 금” and “체크아웃”, “9.27 일”; “예약번호”, “HTL89024”; and “주소 · 장소”. Put optional “예약 링크 · 메모” inside a collapsed disclosure row. Finish with compact “취소” and yellow “예약 저장” buttons. Keep text readable, spacing efficient, all interface copy Korean, and the composition directly reproducible in a responsive working app.
